payload.summary: A table that goes through the policy paragraph by paragraph and says what is being added, deleted or reworded between the 2021 version and the 2026 draft. It is the quickest way to see the substance: new paragraphs on the agent of change principle, on tackling crime against women and other vulnerable people, on conditions restricting high-strength alcohol at off-licences, and on service standards; and the removal of the section on toilet facilities, now dealt with by other legislation. A good many of the entries are renumbering or tidying rather than a change of policy.
